name: Instruction line
summary: The one quiet instruction line on an audience phone: default body copy (16px, regular, deck ink), centred and unboxed, the same on every slide.
highlights: Unboxed: no pill, card or tint
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-instruction-line> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

opinion.note: Never semibold, muted grey, or in a tinted box: that is how every slide ended up styling it differently. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
